propositions: Data Center backend has no unit-level value pinning tests equivalent to Cloud's characterization suite; existing contract tests assert shape only, not values
The create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields emits priority, status, issuetype, assignee, summary, and description fields that must be pinned by value including all default-fallback branches
The shared OutboundFieldMapper through WikiTextCodec is untested for description truncation boundary (WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT) and non-string passthrough, creating regression risk for DC
DC's probe classifier must be pinned for all four branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) through a real transport seam, not the FakeTransport stub
DC must bind its own resolved_statuses configuration distinctly from Cloud's, requiring a non-default set to discriminate (since both default to identical frozenset)
All DC sanitizer boundaries (summary, description, comment) must be pinned at-limit and one-over with the exact truncation suffix marker
